_about: Hand-curated meanings for core Aeries tables and columns, written from Aeries conventions and verified
against this district's database where noted. Everything here is a hint, not a guarantee: confirm against
the Aeries Table/Field Info panel (the (i) icon on any Aeries Web page) before relying on a column.
Edit this file and re-run `npm run generate:aeries-schema` to refresh docs/aeries-schema/.
conventions: One SQL Server database per school year, named DST<yy>000SanLeandroUSD (yy = year the school year starts). The schema is identical across years; only the data differs.
Nearly every table has DEL (bit, 1 = soft-deleted) and DTS (datetime, last change). Always filter DEL = 0.
Student rows are keyed by SC + SN (school code + school-level student number). STU.ID is the district-wide Permanent ID and is the key for IDN, ENR and other cross-school tables.
STU.TG is the status tag: blank = active, anything else = inactive (I), no-show (N), etc. Active-student queries use ISNULL(STU.TG,'') = ''.
Coded columns are decoded through COD: COD.TC = table code, COD.FC = field code, COD.CD = value, COD.DE = description. COD.SC = 0 means district-wide.
Absence codes live in ABS (per school), not COD. ATT.AL is the all-day code; ATT.A0..A9 are the period codes for periods 0-9.
Aeries writes an ATT row only on days a student has at least one mark. Present days have no ATT row, so days enrolled must come from DAY x ENR (or AHS/YTD summaries), never from COUNT(ATT).
School days = DAY rows where HO = '' (HO holds a holiday / non-school indicator). Term boundaries are in TRM (TM = '1'..'4', 'F', 'S', 'Y'; D1 = start, D2 = end).
Sections: MST.SE is the section number; SEC links students (SC, SN) to sections (SE); CRS.CN is the course number; TCH.TN is the teacher number; STU.CU holds the counselor's TCH.TN.
POP holds school options including the grade-posting windows (NM = 'GradeStartDate1'..'GradeEndDate12', OV = mm/dd/yyyy text). These are the windows teachers post marks, not the term dates.
Grade marks: GRD.M1..M12 are the marks for grade reporting windows 1..12. In this district M2 is the Q1 mark at the secondary schools (window 1 is the progress report).

STU.description: Student demographics, one row per student per school (SC + SN). STU.ID is the district Permanent ID.

columns.SN: Student number, unique within the school
columns.GR: Grade level (-1 = TK/pre-K conventions vary; 0 = K)
columns.RC1: Primary race code (COD STU.RC1); 999 = intentionally left blank
columns.LF: Language fluency (COD STU.LF; in this district 1 = English Only, 2 = IFEP, 3 = English Learner, 4 = RFEP, 5 = Adult EL)
columns.TG: Status tag: blank = active; I = inactive, N = no show, etc. (COD STU.TG)
columns.LD: Leave date at this school (null while enrolled)

IDN.description: District-wide student identity record, one row per Permanent ID.

ENR.description: Enrollment history by Permanent ID: one row per student per school per enrollment spell, across years.

columns.YR: School year the enrollment belongs to (start year, e.g. 2026 = 2026-27)

ATT.description: Daily attendance marks, one row per student per day that has at least one mark. No row = present all day.

columns.DY: Day number in the school calendar (DAY.DY)
columns.CD: Enrollment status code on this date (e.g. E = entered, L = left)

ABS.description: Absence code definitions per school. Decodes ATT.AL and ATT.A0..A9.

columns.TY: Absence type number (verified / excused / unexcused / tardy groupings)
columns.AD: Counts as present for attendance-day purposes (1 = present, e.g. school business, in-school suspension, tardy)

DAY.description: School calendar, one row per calendar day per school. HO = '' marks an instructional day.

columns.DY: Day number within the school year
columns.HO: Holiday / non-school indicator; blank = school day
columns.MO: Month number in the attendance calendar

TRM.description: Term definitions per school: quarters, semesters and year with start/end dates.

columns.TM: Term code: 1-4 = quarters, F = fall semester, S = spring semester, Y = year
columns.D1A: Track A term start (tracked schools only)

GRD.description: Current-year grade reporting marks, one row per student per section.

columns.M1: Mark for grade reporting window 1 (progress report at SLUSD secondary schools)
columns.M2: Mark for window 2 (Q1 at SLUSD secondary schools)

GRH.description: History of grade reporting marks for earlier windows in the current year (snapshot per window).

HIS.description: Course history / transcript: every course and mark a student has ever earned, including other schools.

columns.SC: School code of the STU record
columns.TE: Term the mark was earned in
columns.ST: School where the course was taken (CHI code or local school)

MST.description: Master schedule: one row per section offered at a school this year.

columns.TM: Term the section meets (TRM.TM style; 0 = full year at SLUSD)
columns.DY: Days of the week the section meets

SEC.description: Student schedules: which sections each student is enrolled in. Has no entry/exit dates (see CAR for schedule change history).

CAR.description: Course attendance / schedule change history: when students entered and left sections, used for class-level attendance.

CRS.description: Course catalogue (district-wide): one row per course number.

TCH.description: Teachers per school: one row per teacher number. Also used for counselors (STU.CU).

STF.description: Staff demographics (district-wide), keyed by staff ID.

COD.description: Code definitions for coded columns in many tables.

columns.TC: Table code the value belongs to (e.g. STU)
columns.FC: Field code within that table (e.g. LF)

LOC.description: Schools in the district, one row per school code.

POP.description: School-level options as name/value pairs, including grade-posting windows.

PGM.description: Special program participation per student, one row per program spell.

CSE.description: Special education record per student (district managed).

LAC.description: English learner / language assessment record per student.

columns.LF: Language fluency at time of record

ADS.description: Discipline incidents (assertive discipline), one row per incident per student.

DSP.description: Dispositions (consequences) for discipline incidents; several per ADS row.

TST.description: Standardized test score history per student.

CTL.description: Test and test-part definitions (decodes TST.ID / TST.PT).

FRE.description: Free / reduced meal application status per student.

columns.CD: Eligibility code (F = free, R = reduced, N = not eligible)

SUP.description: Supplemental student fields defined by the district (column meanings are district-specific).

DSD.description: District supplemental student fields (column meanings are district-specific; see extended properties).

GRC.description: Valid marks and their grade points / credit rules (decodes GRD.M*, HIS.MK).

SSS.description: Scheduling: next-year student schedule requests (planning copy of SEC).

SMS.description: Scheduling: next-year master schedule (planning copy of MST).

GBS.description: Gradebook scores per student per assignment.

AHS.description: Attendance history summary per student per year: enrolled, present, absent, tardy counts.

YTD.description: Year-to-date attendance totals per student (maintained by Aeries).
